About digital twins

A digital twin is a living virtual replica of your physical asset. It updates in real time, remembers history, and predicts future behaviour.

Melting Twin

Induction furnace state, lining health and LSTM-AE anomaly scoring.

Open twin

Molding Twin

Green sand chemistry — moisture, permeability and compactability.

Open twin

Pouring Twin

Ladle transfer, pour kinetics and upstream risk inherited from melt.

Open twin

Quality Twin

ResNet-50 visual inspection and defect classification.

Open twin

The foundry process

Four stages, one continuous signal path

01

Melting

Charge, melt and hold. Lining health and anomaly signature tracked every 2 seconds.

02

Molding

Green sand prepared and compacted. Moisture and permeability define porosity risk.

03

Pouring

Ladle transfer and pour. Inherits upstream risk from the melt within 2 seconds.

04

Quality

Visual inspection classifies the casting and closes the learning loop.

Project novelty

What makes it different from a plain monitoring dashboard

Most systems tell you what already broke. NEXUS-Foundry connects the stages so a furnace signature at 09:40 becomes a pour decision at 14:48.

Cross-Stage Correlation

Connecting furnace anomalies to casting defects 6+ hours before the pour ever happens.

Physics-Validated What-If

PINN simulation constrained by the heat equation, so every suggestion is physically possible.

Triple-Source RAG

Manuals, live twin state and model outputs combined into one cited, plain-language answer.
